data.title: What hosts ask us.
items: Do I have to leave our WhatsApp group?
No. Keep it for chat. Put the meetups on Catch and share one link in the group; bookings, payments and reminders happen there.
Most of our meetups are free. Is that OK?
Yes. Free events stay free, forever. You only pay 5% when you sell tickets or memberships.
Can I keep some evenings small?
Yes. Turn on applications, ask your own questions and approve each person.
Make a plan with a monthly or yearly price. Members renew by UPI Autopay or card, and get the benefits you choose: a member price, free entry, or booking first.
No. People follow, book, pay and check in on your page in their phone’s browser.
We run chapters in a few cities.
Each chapter can have its own events on your page. Book a walkthrough and we’ll help you set it up.
